title: [GMCP 203.002.M] Mastery: JSON-RPC, protocol metadata, errors, cancellation, and negotiation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-002-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP implements the complete JSON-RPC substrate for every supported revision: identifiers and batches where applicable, notifications, cancellation, progress tokens, typed standard and MCP errors, required resultType, per-request protocol/capability metadata, trace context, and deterministic unsupported-version behavior. Malformed, duplicated, reordered, oversized, and adversarial messages fail predictably without corrupting another request. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
